unit: Unit evidence proves its cited run
notes: Hardens the unit-evidence guard: every cited head must resolve in the repository, every cited run is resolved through the read-only GitHub Actions API, and run.head_sha must equal a head the fragment cites; a missing run, a foreign repository, an unfinished or failed run, a disagreeing head, an unreachable API or an invented SHA fails with a named reason instead of passing; fragments and docs record the run-id/SHA agreement rule; negative proofs run the real HTTP path against a local stub; no aggregate, baseline, oracle or product edit; aggregates parent-owned
